scenarios.title: P&L Dashboard vs Email Match
scenarios.event: After an hourly loop completes, compare the P&L shown in the dashboard hero with the P&L in the email header. They must be identical within $0.01.

scenarios.title: Zero P&L Elimination
scenarios.event: When IBKR has positions with real unrealized P&L (e.g., +$2,247), verify that $0.00 does NOT appear as P&L in any formatted output (dashboard hero, position table, email header, email positions).

scenarios.title: Log Consistency
scenarios.event: Read the full chain log from a loop run. Verify there are no contradictory P&L numbers (e.g., $0.00 in section [9] but +$2,247 in [IBKR] section). All P&L references should agree.

scenarios.title: Single Source of Truth
scenarios.event: Trace every P&L computation in the codebase (dashboard HTML, server.mjs, email script, chain script). Verify all use the same formula: (NetLiq - Cash) - sum(avgPrice * qty).

scenarios.title: IBKR-Only Positions When Connected
scenarios.event: When IB Gateway is connected and returning positions, verify the dashboard position table shows ONLY IBKR positions (SPY, AAPL, NVDA) and does NOT show paper BTC/ETH.

scenarios.title: QwQ Analysis Varies Per Run
scenarios.event: Compare QwQ-32B analysis output from two consecutive loop runs. The analysis should reference different data (updated prices, changed P&L, new signals) not produce identical text.

scenarios.title: IBKR Offline Graceful Degradation
scenarios.event: Simulate IB Gateway being offline (port 4002 unreachable). Dashboard should show 'IBKR OFFLINE' and email should note 'No IBKR data' — NOT show fake numbers or crash.

scenarios.title: Per-Position P&L Sums to Total
scenarios.event: Verify that the sum of individual position P&L values in the dashboard table equals the total Unrealized P&L in the hero section (within $1 tolerance).

criteria: P&L Consistency: Dashboard hero P&L matches email header P&L matches IBKR query P&L within $0.01
No Paper Mixing: When IBKR is connected, zero paper book positions or $0 P&L appear in any output
Log Integrity: The chain log contains one consistent set of P&L numbers, not contradictory sections
Single Formula: All P&L computations use (NetLiq - Cash) - sum(avgPrice * qty)
Data Freshness: IBKR data polled within 60s, QwQ analysis references actual position performance
Error Handling: IBKR offline produces clear messaging, not crashes or fake data
